shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Four different skill shots are available here and you choose between them with the Ring button before you launch.

shots.name: Left Loop / Spinner
shots.notes: Outside loop with a spinner in it. Every spin is 11 points and pushes you further along the map toward Erebor. Also lights the Goblin inlane and collects the dwarf Fili.

shots.name: Right Loop / Spinner
shots.notes: The mirror-image loop and spinner. Feeds Erebor progress the same way, lights the Orc inlane and collects the dwarf Kili.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: The utility ramp. It qualifies Gandalf modes, pages the book forward when BOOK is lit, buys mode time when TIME is lit, and lights the Spider inlane. It crosses the right ramp on the way up.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: The business ramp. Qualifies Bilbo Baggins modes, starts a mode when MODE is lit, takes Smaug Multiball locks, and lights the Warg inlane.

shots.name: ELF Drop Targets
shots.notes: Three drops in the lower left. Clearing the bank qualifies three Elf modes. Behind them sit touch targets for Gloin, Oin and Dwalin.

shots.name: DWARF Drop Targets
shots.notes: A five-bank in the upper left that also walls off the left kicker hole. Clearing it qualifies three Dwarf modes; the targets behind the A, R and F drops collect Bifur, Bofur and Bombur.

shots.name: MAN Drop Targets
shots.notes: Three drops in the lower right. Clearing the bank qualifies Man modes, and the targets behind them collect Nori, Dori and Ori.

shots.name: Left Kicker Hole
shots.notes: Hidden behind the DWARF bank, so you have to clear drops before you can shoot it. Collects Balin, and it is one of the two holes you must hit to bank a lit extra ball.

shots.name: Right Kicker Hole
shots.notes: Always open. Qualifies four Radagast modes, and pairs with the left hole for the extra ball collect.

shots.name: Captive Ball
shots.notes: Sits between the crossing ramps. Collects Thorin, spots a dwarf when it glows blue from Mystery, and is where you cash out the Super Spinner jackpot.

shots.name: LOCK Rollovers
shots.notes: Four rollovers across the middle of the playfield. Completing L-O-C-K is what arms a Smaug lock on the right ramp.

shots.name: Mystery Target
shots.notes: Just right of the right ramp. Pays a Mystery award when lit, and lighting it is level one of a four-level chain that ends with a ball save.

shots.name: Bag End Bumpers
shots.notes: Three pop bumpers tucked between the right kicker hole and the Mystery target. Enough hits here starts Super Jets.

shots.name: Spider
shots.notes: Lower-left beast. Raised by the rightmost inlane or by the left ramp. Killing all four beasts starts Beast Frenzy Multiball.

shots.name: Goblin
shots.notes: Upper-left beast. Raised by the third inlane or by the left loop.

shots.name: Orc
shots.notes: Upper-right beast. Raised by the second inlane or by the right loop.

shots.name: Warg
shots.notes: Lower-right beast. Raised by the leftmost inlane or by the right ramp.

shots.name: Warg Inlane
shots.notes: Outer left inlane. Rolling it while lit pops the Warg up for a short hurry-up.

shots.name: Orc Inlane
shots.notes: Inner left inlane. Raises the Orc when lit; crossing one left and one right inlane also steps the Mystery ladder.

shots.name: Goblin Inlane
shots.notes: Inner right inlane. Raises the Goblin when lit.

shots.name: Spider Inlane
shots.notes: Outer right inlane. Raises the Spider when lit.

shots.name: Left Outlane / Windlance
shots.notes: Carries a kickback with a stopper pin, so a ball parks here rather than draining. Mode starts hold it there until the Ring fires it, and Load Arrow turns that launch into a scoring shot.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Lights for Precioussss once you have climbed all four Mystery levels, which turns a drain into a coin flip you can win.

shots.name: Upper Right Flipper
shots.notes: Feeds across the top of the playfield. During Super Jets this is the flipper you use to knock over the flashing DWARF target.

shots.name: The Ring Button
shots.notes: A third button on the cabinet. It charges from switch hits and then does whatever the game most needs at that moment — fire the kickback, stab a beast, hold off a lock or mode, or just pay points.

goals.title: Dwarf Skill Shot
goals.summary: One of four skill shots the Ring button can arm before you plunge (Dwarf, Elf, Lock, or Inlane) — this one cycles the raised DWARF drop target for an escalating bonus.

steps.action: Press the Ring for Dwarf, then plunge
steps.detail: One of the five DWARF drops stands up and rotates; hitting the right one pays 10,000 plus 1,500 for every skill shot you have already made.

goals.title: Lock Skill Shot
goals.summary: Another of the four Ring-selected skill shots: the LOCK rollovers light gold and pay per rollover caught, climbing every time you land one.
goals.reward: 1,500 x rollovers caught, +500 per skill shot already made

steps.action: Press the Ring for Lock, then plunge
steps.detail: Gold rollovers pay 1,500 multiplied by how many you catch, and the base climbs 500 per successful skill shot.

goals.title: Qualify The Six Mode Families
goals.summary: There are 31 modes split across six families, and each family is unlocked by its own shot. Six shots, six sets of stories — this is the spine of the whole game and everything else hangs off it.

steps.detail: Worth one mode.
The best value on the playfield at five modes qualified.
Four modes.

steps.action: Clear ELF and DWARF for three each
steps.detail: The lower-left bank gives Elf modes, the upper-left bank gives Dwarf modes, and the lower-right MAN bank gives the Man modes.

goals.title: Page The Book, Start The Mode
goals.summary: Qualified modes queue up in the book on the playfield. Shoot the left ramp while BOOK is lit to page to the next one, then the right ramp while MODE is lit to start it. Most modes run 30 seconds; hurry-up modes are a single shot for 2,500.

steps.action: Page to the mode you want
steps.detail: Each left ramp with BOOK lit advances the book one story.
A start is blocked if a Smaug lock is lit or if you have postponed the shot with the Ring.
Whatever the mode wants is lit orange underneath the shots; the book itself shows time left, mode total and next shot value.

goals.title: Buy Mode Time
goals.summary: Timed modes are short and the left ramp is your clock. With TIME lit blue it adds 10 seconds and turns the light purple; purple only pays 3 seconds, and it goes back to blue as soon as you make progress in the mode itself.

steps.detail: Ten seconds on a 30-second mode is a third of the mode back.

steps.action: Score in the mode to reset the light
steps.detail: Any mode progress flips the purple TIME light back to blue so the next ramp is worth 10 seconds again.

goals.title: Smaug Multiball
goals.summary: Complete the L-O-C-K rollovers to arm a lock, then shoot the right ramp. The lock is virtual — Smaug takes the ball, insults you, and spits it out of the left kicker hole. Three locks start a three-ball multiball with jackpots at 3,500 apiece.

steps.detail: The first time in a game, one completion arms all three locks at once.
You can hold the lock off with the Ring if you would rather start a mode first.
Loops, kicker holes, ramps and the captive ball all pay 3,500, and the whole set relights once you clear it.

goals.title: Locks Get Harder Every Time
goals.summary: The lock rules tighten with each Smaug Multiball. The first one is a gift; the second makes you complete L-O-C-K once per lock; the third and beyond make you complete the rollovers and cash the lock before the next set will even start.

steps.detail: Second time around, three completions equal three locks and they can stack up.
From the third multiball on, an uncollected lock blocks the rollovers from starting a new set.

goals.title: Light The Beasts
goals.summary: Four beasts match the four inlanes: Warg, Orc, Goblin and Spider from left to right. Each is woken up by its own major shot — right ramp for Warg, right loop for Orc, left loop for Goblin, left ramp for Spider.

steps.action: Ramps and loops light the inlanes
steps.detail: Right ramp lights Warg, left ramp lights Spider.
Left loop lights Goblin, right loop lights Orc.

steps.action: Roll a lit inlane to raise the beast
steps.detail: The target pops up for a few seconds only. For your first Beast Frenzy a plain inlane roll is enough to light it; after that only the shots work.
A killed beast turns its light yellow and its wall comes down on the display.

goals.title: Beast Frenzy Multiball
goals.summary: Put down all four beasts and a second ball launches. Beasts keep popping out of the playfield for 1,000 a hit. Trap up for a moment and the targets rotate, which opens a window to make a mode start or a mode shot instead.

steps.detail: Order does not matter, only that each one goes down once.
There is a short ball save at the start, so open up rather than nursing the ball.
Holding a ball lets the beast set change so you can reach the shots you actually want.

goals.title: Stack Smaug And Beast
goals.summary: The two multiballs are not exclusive. Smaug Multiball still lets you build beast progress, and Beast Frenzy still lets you light and cash Smaug locks. Starting one on top of the other adds a ball.

steps.action: Hold one while you build the other
steps.detail: Arm L-O-C-K but leave the lock uncollected while you are lighting beasts.
The add-a-ball only arrives if you bring the second one in while the first is still running.

goals.title: Collect All Thirteen Dwarves
goals.summary: Thorin's whole company is scattered across thirteen different shots, most of them touch targets hiding behind drop targets. Getting all thirteen starts Feast Frenzy, and the set then resets so you can do it again.

steps.detail: Gloin, Oin and Dwalin sit behind the lower-left drops.
Bifur, Bofur and Bombur are back there; the D and W drops have nothing behind them.
Nori, Dori and Ori.

steps.action: Spinners, holes and the captive ball
steps.detail: Fili is on the left spinner, Kili on the right, Balin in the left kicker hole and Thorin on the captive ball.

goals.title: Feast Frenzy
goals.summary: The reward for reuniting the company. For a short window the drop targets themselves are worth real points, so hammer banks rather than hunting for the touch targets behind them. When it ends the dwarves can be collected again.

steps.detail: Lower-left and lower-right banks are the easiest to hit repeatedly from a trapped ball.
The clock is short — take whatever bank the ball is already pointing at.

goals.title: The Road To Erebor
goals.summary: Both spinners feed a map that runs from the Shire to the Lonely Mountain. Every spin is 11 points and a step along the trail. It takes a very large number of spins, which makes clean loop shots the quiet long game of this machine.
goals.reward: 11 points a spin, progress to Super Spinner

steps.detail: A full-speed loop is worth many times a dribble through the lane.
Both feed the same map, so take whichever side the ball gives you.

goals.title: Super Spinner
goals.summary: Reach Erebor on the map and Super Spinners runs for 60 seconds. Every further spin stacks a jackpot that is sitting there uncollected — and the only way to bank it is to shoot the captive ball, which also ends the mode.
goals.reward: 60 seconds of spinner value plus a stored jackpot

steps.detail: Keep looping until the clock is nearly gone rather than cashing early.
This ends Super Spinners, so time it — but do not let the clock run out with the jackpot unclaimed.

goals.title: The Four Mystery Levels
goals.summary: Cross one left inlane and one right inlane to step the Mystery ladder. Level one lights the Mystery target, level two lights the captive ball, level three lights Load Arrow at the left outlane, and level four lights Precioussss at the right outlane.
goals.reward: Mystery awards, a spotted dwarf, and a ball save

steps.detail: Any combination of a left-side and a right-side inlane advances the ladder one level.
Awards include Advance Erebor, Super Jets, Light Kickback, Light Beasts, a spotted dwarf, bonus multiplier, and an extra tilt warning.

steps.action: Take the blue captive ball at level two
steps.detail: Worth a free dwarf, which is the cheapest dwarf in the game.

goals.title: The Extra Tilt Warning
goals.summary: One of the Mystery awards adds a tilt warning on top of the normal allowance. It is easy to skip past, but it is genuinely the most valuable thing in the pool — it buys you a hard save you could not otherwise risk.
goals.reward: One more nudge before you tilt
instructions: Cross one left inlane and one right inlane to light the Mystery target, then collect it.
The extra warning goes beyond the machine's normal threshold, so you are not just replacing a used warning.
Bank it early in a ball, not late — its value is that it lets you save a ball you would otherwise let go.
With it in hand you can commit to a real nudge on a shot heading for an outlane instead of watching it drain.

goals.title: Load Arrow
goals.summary: Mystery level three turns the left outlane into a weapon. At the start of your next mode the kickback strength is shown on a swinging power meter — stop it with the Ring, and the ball fires out of the outlane at the MAN targets for points.

steps.action: Let the ball park in the outlane
steps.detail: The stopper pin holds it there at the start of a mode instead of draining it.
The meter swings; the button freezes it and sets how hard the Windlance fires.

steps.action: Aim across at the MAN bank
steps.detail: Hitting that bank from the launch is what pays.

goals.title: Precioussss
goals.summary: The top of the Mystery ladder and the best ball save in the game. With the right outlane lit, draining there brings up a moving line and a blue window. Stop the line inside the window with the Ring and your ball comes back.
goals.reward: The ball back from a right outlane drain

steps.detail: Mystery, captive ball and Load Arrow all have to be lit before the outlane will light.

steps.action: Stop the line in the blue
steps.detail: Inside the window and play carries on; miss and you sit and watch your bonus count up.

goals.title: Super Jets And The Barrels
goals.summary: Enough hits in Bag End starts Super Jets. From then on jet hits load dwarves into barrels, and the barrels are knocked over by hitting the flashing DWARF target with the upper right flipper. Five knocked over is half of what you need for the extra ball.
goals.reward: Progress toward the lit extra ball

steps.detail: The right kicker hole and loose balls off the top both drop into Bag End.
It is the only flipper with a clean line across to the flashing target.
Each hit on the flashing DWARF target tips one barrel.

goals.title: Light And Bank The Extra Ball
goals.summary: The extra ball has two prerequisites and two collect shots. Qualify every mode in the game and tip five barrels during Super Jets, and the extra ball lights — then you have to hit both kicker holes to actually take it.

steps.detail: When all of them are queued a travelling drop target lights for points and the requirement clears.
Barrels usually come quicker than qualifying every mode, but both have to be done before the extra ball lights.
The right hole is the easy half.
The left hole needs the DWARF drops out of the way first, so clear them before you go looking.

goals.title: Charge And Spend The Ring
goals.summary: The Ring button charges from switch hits and then does whatever is most useful right then. It fires the kickback, gives you a free swing at a beast, holds off a lock or a mode start, and when nothing else applies it just pays 1,000 with a growing bonus.
goals.reward: Backstabs, postponed shots, or escalating points

steps.detail: Bumpers and target banks fill it fastest.
During a beast hurry-up the Ring gives you a chance at the kill without a clean shot.

steps.action: Postpone a lock or a mode
steps.detail: This is how you keep the right ramp doing what you want when a lock and a mode start are fighting over it.

goals.title: Light An Arkenstone Mode
goals.summary: The end of the road. Finish a mode, start both Smaug Multiball and Beast Frenzy, reach Super Spinners, and collect all thirteen dwarves — then an Arkenstone mode lights. One of three will be waiting: Into the Fire, Barrel Escape, Battle of the Five Armies.

steps.detail: Completed, not just started and timed out.
Smaug and Beast Frenzy each have to be started.
Super Spinners has to have run at least once.
All thirteen dwarves collected is usually the last requirement standing.

achievements.title: Chosen Before The Plunge
achievements.desc: Land any of the four skill shots.

achievements.title: Turn The Page
achievements.desc: Qualify a mode, page to it with the left ramp and start it on the right.

achievements.title: Wake The Dragon
achievements.desc: Complete L-O-C-K three times over and start Smaug Multiball.

achievements.title: Four Beasts Down
achievements.desc: Raise and kill the Warg, Orc, Goblin and Spider to start Beast Frenzy.

achievements.title: Both At Once
achievements.desc: Bring Smaug Multiball and Beast Frenzy together for the add-a-ball.

achievements.title: Up The Ladder
achievements.desc: Climb the Mystery ladder to level four and light the right outlane.

achievements.title: It Came Back
achievements.desc: Win a Precioussss save on a right outlane drain.

achievements.title: The Lonely Mountain
achievements.desc: Spin your way to Erebor and start Super Spinners.

achievements.title: Thorin And Company
achievements.desc: Collect all thirteen dwarves in a single pass.

achievements.title: Barrel Rider
achievements.desc: Tip five barrels during Super Jets with the upper right flipper.

achievements.title: The Arkenstone
achievements.desc: Meet every requirement and light an Arkenstone mode.

drills.title: Ring Skill-Shot Ladder
drills.text: Cycle the Ring through the four skill shots before you plunge and run the Dwarf and Lock picks twice each so the button press becomes part of the launch. Dwarf pays off the one drop that stands up and rotates, Lock pays per gold rollover you catch, and both climb with every skill shot already banked.

drills.title: Page The Book, Then Start It
drills.text: Left ramp with BOOK lit to page to the mode you actually want, right ramp with MODE lit to start it. Shoot the pair as one unit until you stop settling for whatever story happened to be showing.

drills.title: Full-Speed Spinner Rips
drills.text: Take both loops at full strength and judge the shot by the spinner, not by where the ball ends up — a dribble through the lane is worth a fraction of a clean rip, and the road to Erebor is paid for in spins. Alternate sides so neither loop becomes the one you avoid.

drills.title: Trapped-Ball Bank Sweeps
drills.text: Cradle the ball and work the lower-left ELF bank and the lower-right MAN bank from the trap, resetting the cradle between hits instead of swinging at the rebound. Those are the two banks you can hit repeatedly from a held ball, which is the whole of Feast Frenzy.

drills.title: Ramp, Inlane, Beast
drills.text: Right ramp to light the Warg inlane, take the inlane feed, then put the Warg down before it drops back under. Run the mirror chain on the other side with the left ramp and the Spider so both halves of the beast set feel the same.

drills.title: Upper-Flipper Barrel Reps
drills.text: Feed Bag End until Super Jets starts, then work the flashing DWARF target with the upper right flipper alone — it is the only flipper with a clean line across to it. Own that timing before the barrels are the last thing standing between you and a lit extra ball.

actionButton.label: The Ring
actionButton.location: a third button on the cabinet, beyond the two flipper buttons
actionButton.how: The Ring is a third cabinet button that changes job constantly. It charges off switch hits and then does whatever the game most needs at that instant, so what a press gets you depends entirely on what is happening. Watch the backbox screen for its state — there is no instant info screen to fall back on.

uses.what: Cycles the four skill shots — Dwarf, Elf, Lock or Inlane. Pick one, then launch.

uses.when: Ball held in the left outlane
uses.what: Fires the Windlance kickback and puts the ball back into play on your terms.

uses.when: Load Arrow armed, power meter swinging
uses.what: Freezes the meter and sets kickback strength. Aim the launch into the MAN drop targets.

uses.when: Draining the right outlane with Precioussss lit
uses.what: Stop the moving line inside the blue window and the ball comes back.
Backstabs the beast — a free crack at the kill without needing the clean shot.

uses.when: Lock or mode waiting on the right ramp
uses.what: Postpones it so you can start what you actually want first.

howItPlays.objective: The Hobbit retells the journey to the Lonely Mountain across dozens of story modes. Qualify and run those stories from the book, rouse Smaug and the four beasts for multiball, reunite all thirteen dwarves, and rip the spinners to Erebor to light an Arkenstone mode.
loop: Press the Ring to pick one of the four skill shots, then plunge.
Qualify the six mode families at their own shots - the right ramp is the richest - then page the book forward with the left ramp and start a story with the right.
Complete L-O-C-K for a Smaug lock and wake the beasts at their inlanes; either multiball still feeds the other, so start one on top of the other for an added ball.
Rip both spinners to walk the map to Erebor for Super Spinners, and gather all thirteen dwarves for Feast Frenzy.
Finish a mode outright, get both multiballs running, reach Super Spinners and complete the company - that quartet lights an Arkenstone mode.

lights.name: Mode Family Qualifiers
lights.lit: Each of the six family shots lights up as it queues its stories into the book - the left ramp for Gandalf, the right ramp for Bilbo, the right kicker hole for Radagast, and the ELF, DWARF and MAN banks for their own sets.
lights.then: Spread your shots so every family is stocked, leaning on the right ramp for the deepest run of stories. Those queued stories drive everything else on the machine, and stocking all six is also half of what lights the extra ball.

lights.name: The Book Ramps
lights.lit: With BOOK lit the left ramp pages to the next queued story, and with MODE lit the right ramp starts whatever the book is showing.
lights.flashing: A blue TIME lamp on the left ramp adds a chunk of clock; it dims to purple once used, and mode progress flips it back to blue.
lights.then: Page to the story you actually want before you start it, rather than settling for whatever is open. The right ramp will not start a story while a Smaug lock is lit there or while the Ring is holding the shot off, so clear that traffic first.

lights.name: L-O-C-K Rollovers
lights.lit: The four rollovers across the mid-playfield light one letter at a time; finishing L-O-C-K arms a Smaug lock at the right ramp.
lights.then: Shoot the armed right ramp and Smaug swallows the ball, mocks you, and spits it from the left kicker hole for a virtual lock. Three locks start a three-ball multiball, and the rules tighten each time - later locks want the rollovers redone and cashed before a new set will build.

lights.name: The Four Beasts
lights.lit: Each beast rises for only a few seconds when you roll its matching lit inlane, and that inlane is lit by its own major shot - the ramps and loops - not by any flipper tap.
lights.then: Wake a beast and put it down before it drops back under; a kill turns its light yellow. Flatten all four and a second ball launches for Beast Frenzy, where trapping up rotates the set so you can reach the shots you want.

lights.name: The Mystery Ladder
lights.lit: Crossing one left return lane and one right steps the Mystery ladder a level, and each level lights its own shot in turn - the Mystery target, the captive ball, then the two outlanes.
lights.then: Cash Mystery for anything from Advance Erebor to a spotted dwarf, and keep climbing: the third level arms Load Arrow to fire the parked ball out of the left outlane, and the fourth lights Precioussss so a right-outlane drain becomes a save you can win with the Ring.

lights.name: The Road To Erebor
lights.lit: Both spinners drive a single trail that climbs toward the Lonely Mountain, and each spin is a few points plus one more step down that road - so a clean rip counts for many times a lazy dribble.
lights.then: It is a long haul of spins, which quietly makes tidy loop shots this machine's endurance event. Reach Erebor and Super Spinners runs for a spell, stacking an uncollected jackpot that you bank - and end the mode - by shooting the captive ball.

lights.name: Thorin's Company
lights.lit: All thirteen dwarves are scattered across the playfield, most on touch targets tucked behind the drop banks and the rest on the spinners, the left kicker hole and the captive ball.
lights.then: Track the company down one by one to start Feast Frenzy, a short window where the drop targets themselves pay, so hammer whole banks instead of hunting the hidden targets. Finish it and the dwarves relight for another pass.

scoring.text: Cycle the Ring to a skill shot before you plunge, then stock the book by qualifying mode families - the right ramp gives the most for one shot. Page and start a story you can actually complete, and cross the return lanes to climb the Mystery ladder for its awards and ball saves.

Arm L-O-C-K for Smaug Multiball and wake the four beasts for Beast Frenzy, then bring one in on top of the other for the add-a-ball. Grind the spinners toward Super Spinners and round up all thirteen dwarves, and lean on Bag End and the upper flipper to tip barrels toward the extra ball.

An Arkenstone mode is the destination, and it asks for the lot in one game: complete a story outright, get Smaug Multiball and Beast Frenzy both going, run Super Spinners, and reunite the entire company. Clear that checklist and one of the three Arkenstone stories lights up.
